invariants.rationale: A commit instant (instantTime) is typically required to be non-null for commit operations.
The partitionRecordsMap should not be null to be safely operated on; null would likely cause errors in subsequent logic.
If the partitionRecordsMap is not empty, all its keys (partition names) should be non-null to ensure correct partition addressing.
If the partitionRecordsMap is not empty, all HoodieData values should be non-null for correct data representation.
If there are no records to commit, perhaps instantTime needs to be non-empty to indicate a valid no-operation commit.
